media:content.media:description: NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket at Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on Saturday.

media:content.media:text: Scientists in a cherry picker observe the top of the Nancy Grace Roman Telescope at NASA Goddard Space Center in Greenbelt, Md. on May 22.
media:content.media:description: The $4.3 billion mission has been under development for nearly two decades and is set to launch nine months ahead of schedule.

media:content.media:text: Nancy Grace Roman Telescope
media:content.media:description: Though the Roman telescope is often compared to Hubble, which launched in 1990 and has captured some of the most dramatic and memorable views of the cosmos, Roman’s capabilities far outpace its predecessor’s.

item.title: NASA launches its next-generation space telescope
